name: rollcall_vscurrying
about: Roll call: classname npc_VScurrying builds CNPC_VScurrying (factory 0x103aba00, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). One row taken verbatim from la_hub_1 (CabbieSewer) stands in the arena; NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: on its first thinks the class's SelectSchedule (its own override or the Troika arm it inherits) picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it; the program then runs (StartTask/RunTask) for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
known_red: new: a StartHidden npc_VScurrying row gathers at 0 s but installs no schedule, before or after ScriptUnhide at 0.5 s
notes: Every standable row of npc_VScurrying is StartHidden; the record unhides it at 0.5 s, as its map's wire does.
